PRICE MODEL

History in. One session ahead.

TimesFM 2.5 uses 256 previous stock closes. Its pretrained weights stay frozen. The adaptive layer blends its estimate with a no-change baseline and a bias correction.

RESEARCH AGENT

Context, in a separate lane.

Gemini analyses commodity headlines and builds an evidence map. It does not train TimesFM or change these stock forecasts.

Model reference and measurement details

Error is the absolute price miss divided by the previous close, expressed in percentage points. The chart compares the mean error on the same outcomes. Baseline means predicting an unchanged closing price.

Historical forecasts were generated after the fact from downloaded data. The replay applies updates in chronological order, but provider revisions and model pretraining overlap remain possible. It is not a live record or proof of a trading advantage.
